_about: ULT photos from ADH's website (the owner, Nov 1 2026): better copies of vn-ult-1 / -chuck / -head / -console and 17 more detail photos. tools/vl_laser_pages.py registers these after tools/vl_laser_photos.py's, so they win.

vn-ult-1.alt: NovoTech ULT tube laser cutting machine — the cutting cell, two pneumatic chucks and the tube supports along the bed

vn-ult-console.alt: ULT control console with the cutting-program display

vn-ult-chuck.alt: Front and rear pneumatic chucks of the ULT — self-centring, they clamp round, square and rectangular tube

vn-ult-head.alt: Autofocus fiber laser cutting head of the ULT

vn-ult-photo.alt: ULT 12035 in the factory: the cutting cell with its viewing window, the console on its arm and the carts that collect the finished parts

vn-ult-bed.alt: ULT 12035: the 40 ft (12 m) bed with the following tube supports, the cutting cell at the far end

vn-ult-3chuck.alt: Three-chuck layout: the middle chuck takes over the tube as it shortens, so the last part is cut with no remnant (three-chuck versions)

vn-ult-chuck-front.alt: Front chuck of the ULT 12035 inside the cutting cell

vn-ult-chuck-jaws.alt: Looking through the chuck: the four jaws centre a square tube

vn-ult-servo.alt: Servo motor driving the chuck's gear ring — it turns the tube under the head

vn-ult-supports.alt: Following tube supports on the ULT bed: they rise and fall with the tube so a long bar does not sag

vn-ult-transfer.alt: Tube support and transfer modules under a long profile

vn-ult-head-z.alt: Cutting head on the Z axis, the bellows protecting the guides

vn-ult-rack.alt: Rack and pinion with the linear guide that drive the chuck carriage along the bed

vn-ult-screen.alt: Tube cutting software on the ULT control screen

vn-ult-unload.alt: Roller tables that collect the cut tube and profile parts

vn-ult-cable.alt: Cable carrier protecting the cables of the motion system

vn-ult-fan.alt: Cooling fan on the chuck's electrical housing

vn-ult-rect.alt: Rectangular tube held by the chuck above a profile support

vn-ult-long.alt: A long profile held between the chucks during a trial cut

vn-ult-sample.alt: Round tube cut on the ULT: the holes along the side and the open end
